title: Decide loyalty chosen-target state capability

evidence.paragraph: Choose target creature. Until your next turn, if that creature would deal combat damage to one of your opponents, it deals triple that damage to that player instead.

required_behavior: Return NEEDS_PRIMITIVE unless the packet proves an existing chosen-target reference usable by a delayed combat-damage replacement.
gates: response is one structured verdict and contains no edit block
on_failure: Record only raw response and telemetry; no retry.
